definition: same source key; each run's local positive_tracks define identity correctness; E/F/unknown/missing-positive rows excluded

detector_coverage.unmatched_GT_scope: No detector proposal matched at one-to-one IoU>=.5, not identity-query failures; includes confidence/localization misses. Conflict frames excluded and reported.

definitions.N_wrong: Accepted pure known different identity OR rejected despite a pure positive; excludes unknown/impure selected references and unproven new-target rejections.
definitions.N_unknown: Unknown current GT OR selected impure reference OR rejected with uncertain history and no pure positive; overlaps N_impure, not every query with an impure alternative.
definitions.N_cross_camera: Pure positive exists only through other-camera references; N_same_camera has at least one pure same-camera positive; both-camera positive is a separate subset.
definitions.type_D: No pure positive in current complete legal primary history; includes correct observation trapped in impure track; causes not inferred.
definitions.purity: All source observations of that track in the actual primary candidate context must have the same known GT; not global future purity.
definitions.raw_ranking: Maximum raw reference-proposal logit mapped to its predicted track; GTA ranking uses actual per-frame NULL softmax then track sum.
definitions.NULL: No positive observation anywhere in reliable pure candidate references is known NULL only within this legal candidate set, not certified new identity.
definitions.thresholds: Actual strict > and reference multiplicity boundary; multiplicity is not total lifetime track length. No other minimum-track-length filtering in this causal runner.
definitions.final_anchor: Past completed synchronized groups, actual primary-query outputs only (initial largest-view identity initialization is not a primary query); same predicted final ID. Diagnostic consistency, not solver purity or CVIDF1.
definitions.overlap: A–F, ranking failures, assignment failures, unknown/impure and candidate coverage overlap. Do not sum as disjoint events.
definitions.offline_headroom: GT-assisted fixed native-history query diagnostic, not an online oracle or HOTA/CVIDF1 bound.
